hero.headline: Privacy policy
hero.subheadline: How we collect and process your data when you enquire about a property.

items.a: Name, email, phone, property of interest and approximate budget, when you submit a form or message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: What do we use it for?
items.a: To respond to your property enquiry, coordinate viewings and, with your opt-in, share new listings that match your search criteria.

items.q: With whom do we share it?
items.a: CRM (HubSpot) and email provider (Mailchimp) under data-processing agreements. We never share your data with other buyers, sellers or third parties for marketing.

items.q: How long do we keep it?
items.a: 24 months after last contact, unless required by law or while an active transaction is ongoing.

items.q: How do I exercise my rights?
items.a: Email info@nexapropiedades.com and we respond within 30 days (access, rectification, deletion, portability).
